activity_summary: You came off the bed with the three words written and nothing in your hands. Alse brought you to the cloak. Mistress Ansell was already at the street door and called up. Gib had not moved. You started down the long way round him.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Took the cloak, stepped wide of the cat, refused the moon an hour, and went.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Kept the tread's news current and turned him toward the door.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Called from the street door, and would not put the cloth down to wave him off.
